title: SaaS Changelog & Status Page Watcher input

urls.title: Changelog / status page URLs
urls.description: Vendor changelog or status pages to watch. Optional per-URL fields: selector, label, pageKind (changelog|status|auto).

cssSelector.title: CSS selector (optional)
cssSelector.description: Limit extraction to this CSS selector (e.g. main, #changelog). Per-URL selector overrides this.

pageKind.title: Page kind
pageKind.description: Hint for labeling extracted events. auto detects from page text.

renderMode.title: Page rendering
renderMode.description: auto uses HTTP first and falls back to a headless browser when the page looks empty or blocked. http never uses a browser. browser always renders with Chromium.

includeUnchanged.title: Output a row for unchanged pages
includeUnchanged.description: When on, unchanged pages get one no_change row so every run shows what was checked.

ignoreTextPatterns.title: Ignore text matching (regex)
ignoreTextPatterns.description: Lines matching these regexes are ignored in text diffs (e.g. rotating dates, visitor counters).

webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL (optional)
webhookUrl.description: POST one JSON payload with all detected changes. Works with Slack and Discord incoming webhooks; also includes a full changes array for Zapier/Make/n8n.

webhookHeaders.title: Webhook headers (optional)
webhookHeaders.description: Extra HTTP headers to send with the webhook, for example an Authorization header.

webhookOnBaseline.title: Send webhook for first-run baselines
webhookOnBaseline.description: By default the first run of a URL only saves a baseline and does not notify. Turn on to also send baseline rows to the webhook.

stateStoreName.title: State store name
stateStoreName.description: Named key-value store that keeps snapshots between runs. Letters, digits and hyphens only.

maxConcurrency.title: Max parallel pages
maxConcurrency.description: How many pages to check at the same time. Keep it low (1-3) on small memory.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Most changelog/status pages load without a proxy.
